EXAM MECHANICS CONFIRMED (item count) / HEDGED (passing score): The manual itself states, under 'What will the knowledge and vision tests include?': 'The knowledge examination will consist of 16 questions taken from parts of this manual and the Connecticut Driver's Manual for New Drivers.' This 16-question count and the $40 combined knowledge+vision test fee were independently confirmed on the official CT.gov page portal.ct.gov/dmv/licenses-permits-ids/get-learners-permit/get-motorcycle-learners-permit ('The 16-question knowledge test is based on information from the Connecticut Motorcycle Operator's Manual and the Connecticut Driver's Manual... $40 for the motorcycle knowledge and vision test'). However, neither the manual nor any official CT.gov page checked this session publishes an exact passing score or percentage for the motorcycle knowledge test -- this MUST be flagged as unconfirmed in the EXAM_CONFIGS code comment at wiring time; do not substitute another state's passing percentage. Separately confirmed via CT DOT/CONREP course pages (portal.ct.gov/dot/programs/conrep-basic-rider-course) that completing an approved novice motorcycle-training course waives the on-cycle skills test only -- the knowledge test and its fee remain required regardless of course completion, consistent with preliminary research.
